period_note: *** THE INSOLVENCY CROSSING QUARTER *** Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account from National Bank's 2nd-Quarter 2025 unaudited financial statements; plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)'/'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)' sections used (Solo+OBU basis). Comparative column (31 Dec 2024) reproduces the known FY2024 Q4 equity of 3208.10m exactly. TOTAL SHAREHOLDERS' EQUITY IS NOW NEGATIVE: -6720.15m, down from +939.67m at 31 March 2025 -- National Bank's balance sheet crossed from solvent to insolvent SOMETIME BETWEEN 31 MARCH 2025 AND 30 JUNE 2025, i.e. during the second quarter of calendar 2025. The discrete April-June 2025 net loss was -7659.92m (this filing's own third P&L column), which almost exactly matches the quarter's equity decline (939.67 - (-6720.15) = 7659.82m, differing from the reported loss by under 0.1m) -- confirming the crossing was driven essentially entirely by this single quarter's operating loss, not by any other equity adjustment, dividend, or write-down. Net Asset Value per share printed in the source as a POSITIVE '2.09' but this is a sign-dropping artifact of the same kind seen throughout this bank's OCR'd filings: given equity is unambiguously negative (confirmed via the balance-sheet identity, Total Liabilities 520305.39m + Total Equity -6720.15m = Total Assets 513585.24m exactly), NAV per share must also be negative (-6720.15m / 3219.74m shares = -2.09), and is recorded here as -2.09, not +2.09 as literally printed. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2025 (first of four P&L columns: [Jan-Jun 2025] [Jan-Jun 2024] [Apr-Jun 2025] [Apr-Jun 2024]). Tax again includes a large deferred-tax credit (Provision for taxation +99.89m, Deferred tax income -8481.40m, net -8381.51m), which is why PAT (-9919.34m) is smaller in magnitude than Profit before tax (-18300.85m). NEGATIVE-EQUITY-BREAKS-ROE RULE APPLIES FROM THIS QUARTER ONWARD: any ROE calculation for this or any later NBL quarter is NULL, not computed as a raw PAT/equity ratio, because both the loss and the equity denominator are negative and would otherwise produce a misleadingly positive percentage (this is the exact failure mode already documented in this dataset's own FY2025 Q4 ratios_timeseries.json entry -- see sources.json for a note on that pre-existing issue). Source PDF was image-only; text obtained via OCR (tesseract, 300dpi).
